actors.policy: Remove complete private Reasoning/reasoning and analysis-channel records, including nested event payloads, and all encrypted_content fields. Apply the same removal to embedded Codex stdout JSONL. Preserve observable prompts, context, actions, tool outputs, assistant replies, and token usage. Original changed files remain in the private backup; actor and judge raw evidence remains separate.

judges.policy: Remove complete private Reasoning/reasoning and analysis-channel records, including nested event payloads, and all encrypted_content fields. Apply the same removal to embedded Codex stdout JSONL. Preserve observable prompts, context, actions, tool outputs, assistant replies, and token usage. Original changed files remain in the private backup; actor and judge raw evidence remains separate.

snapshot_verification.limitation: Snapshots retain original hashes and replacement-decoded text, not binary bytes. Published redaction may also change text. Only exact text reconstruction is independently hash-verified here.

notes: Rates use graded cells only; planned and missing counts remain explicit.
Judge modes contain semantic checks only; combined modes add deterministic checks.
Input tokens include cached input tokens; cached tokens are not added again.
Paired results compare summed scores within the same case/repetition and omit incomplete pairs.
A paired check category with no criteria in a case is not applicable, not incomplete.
No confidence intervals, inferred prices, or semantic adjudication are produced.
